stem:
Sameer compares $5.1\times 10^{4}$ and $4.7\times 10^{5}$.

Which two claims are correct?

options.text: Compare only the coefficients $5.1$ and $4.7$ and ignore the powers of $10$.
$4.7\times 10^{5}$ is larger because the exponent $5$ is greater than $4$.
Order of magnitude is checked first; the larger exponent decides before coefficients are compared.
Add each coefficient to its exponent ($5.1+4$ versus $4.7+5$) to decide the order.

teacher.key_rationale: Compare exponents first: 5>4 so 4.7×10^5 is larger. Ignoring powers or adding coefficient to exponent mishandles the comparison.
